verdict.rationale: MoonPay's docs include a dedicated webhooks section stating it sends webhook events to notify your application whenever an activity occurs on your account. They also document a specific event, sell_transaction_requote_required, for handling requotes. The community post only asks where the event list is and does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: a documented event catalog, details on subscribing or managing endpoints, signature verification, retry/delivery guarantees, and independent hands-on corroboration.
